policy.canonical_assets: Retain everything required by the public single-structure 1D+3D default and its documented local reproduction path.
policy.rebuild_sources: Retain primary FASTA, fold manifests, ESMFold/full-atom structures, and the audited PepFlow plus AF2 16-30 conformer sources used to establish the full2795 lineage.
policy.rejected_experiments: Retain compact protocol, summary, decision and prediction evidence; remove disposable checkpoints, server archives and experiment-specific feature tensors.
policy.test_time_conformers: Disabled and absent from the canonical public interface.

removed_disposable_classes: server upload/download archives and checksum sidecars
rejected ProtT5-structure adapter, geometry-SSL and cross-view feature tensors
rejected 1-50 pilot3195, PepFlow-only and BioEmu-boundary processed tensors
noncanonical candidate checkpoints while retaining their compact metrics
AF2 31-50 raw/cache payload while retaining its tracked pilot cohort manifest
reproducibility_note: Historical rejected experiments whose large caches were removed require regeneration from their retained protocol and source manifests. Their conclusions remain available as compact machine-readable evidence under experiments/test_multiconformer_archive and runs/.
